meta.title: Nora
meta.description: Nora's portal: where the circle is, what's coming up, the game servers, and what she remembers.

login.title: The circle's side of Nora.
login.lede: Where everyone is, what's coming up, the game servers, and what she remembers about you. Sign in with the Discord account she already knows.
login.footnote: Only people Nora already knows can get in. Nobody else sees any of this.
login.deniedTitle: That Discord account isn't on the list.
login.deniedAs: You signed in as {name}. Ask Miles to add that account, or try another one.
login.deniedBody: Ask Miles to add it, or try another account.
login.signedOut: Signed out. Everything this device kept has been cleared.
login.error: Discord sign-in didn't finish. Try again.
login.devBody: Only on a development server. Pick someone from the dev roster.
login.portraitAlt: Nora: a small 3D figure with a messy dark-brown bun, an oversized grey hoodie, loose jeans, white sneakers and white wired earphones, standing with her hands in her pockets.
login.portraitNightAlt: Nora standing in the same pose in a dim room, late at night, lit by a warm lamp.
login.caption: Earphones in.

plans.title: Plans
plans.lede: Dinners, outings, anything the group has asked Nora to hold on to. Plans are made in the group chat; this is where you look them up.
plans.empty: Tag Nora in the group chat to set something up, and it shows up here.
plans.emptyPast: Plans that have happened, or were called off, collect here.
plans.notFound: You can open the plans you made or answered. This one isn't among them, or it no longer exists.
plans.copied: Copied the plan and its link.
plans.answerInChat: Answering happens in the group chat. Tell Nora there.

documents.title: Documents
documents.lede: Write-ups Nora has made for a room you're in: a trip, a comparison, a summary. Ask her in the chat; this is where you read them.
documents.empty: When Nora writes one up for a room you're in, it shows here.
documents.notFound: You can open documents you asked for, or that were made in a room you're in. This one isn't among them, or it no longer exists.

map.empty: Nobody shares where they are with Nora yet. Whoever joins her Life360 circle shows up here.
map.trailSummary: {distance} since {since}. Positions within 10 m count as one stop, so a phone sitting still doesn't wander.
map.trailEmpty: No movement recorded in this window.

people.lede: Everyone Nora knows, and where they are if they share it with her.

places.note: Worked out from where someone settles, not from what they say. Home and work carry how sure she is.

memory.title: Her memory of you
memory.lede: What Nora has written down about you from the group chats. Only you can see this page.
memory.private: Only you can see this. Nobody else in the circle can open your page's memory, and Nora won't describe it to anyone.
memory.partial: Part of her memory didn't answer just now, so this may be missing things.
memory.unreachable: Her memory didn't answer. This isn't the same as there being nothing.
memory.empty: She hasn't concluded anything about you yet. It builds slowly from what you say in the rooms.

noraPage.lede: Nora is an AI who lives with this circle, in its Signal, WhatsApp, Discord and Instagram groups. She listens, keeps track of what matters, and answers when someone tags her.
noraPage.aside: She's an AI, and says so if you ask. This portal is for the people she lives with: she can't open it herself, and won't describe what's in it.
noraPage.statusUnavailable: Her status didn't come back just now. That isn't the same as her being down.
noraPage.recordDown: Having trouble; she may miss things
noraPage.memoryDown: Unreachable; she may not remember today
noraPage.remindersCount: {count, plural, one {# reminder waiting} other {# reminders waiting}} across the rooms.
noraPage.remindersEmpty: No reminders waiting in any room.
noraPage.remindersMore: {count, plural, one {# more} other {# more}} after these.
noraPage.remindersPrivacy: What a reminder says, and who asked for it, stays in the room it was set in. Only the time and the platform show here.
noraPage.memoryLede: What she has concluded about you. Only you can see it.
noraPage.memoryCount: {n, plural, one {# thing remembered} other {# things remembered}}
noraPage.doctrineLede: The words every reply of hers is held to, as she reads them now.
noraPage.abilitiesLede: Every tool she can use and every skill she can load, straight from what's running.

doctrine.title: How she behaves
doctrine.lede: The words every reply of hers is held to, in the order she reads them. Each part carries its version, which moves when the part is rewritten.
doctrine.empty: Her doctrine didn't come back with any parts.
doctrine.footnote: This is what is deployed now, read live. She is held to it; she doesn't quote it.
doctrine.versionHelp: Which revision of this part she is running.

abilities.title: What she can do
abilities.lede: Every tool she can call and every skill she can load, read live from what's running. A new one shows up here without the portal changing.
abilities.searchTools: Search tools by name or what they do
abilities.noTools: No tools came back from her registry.
abilities.noSkills: She has no skills loaded right now.
abilities.toolsNote: Descriptions are the ones she reads when choosing a tool, word for word.
abilities.skillsNote: A skill's instructions reach her only when she loads it for a turn; until then she sees its description alone.

fact.budget: Up to {n, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} a turn
fact.anyTime: Can look at another day or time

effect.none: Can't change anything outside the turn
effect.unknown: May have changed things if it times out

abilities.noInstructions: The running version doesn't share this skill's instructions.
